title: GSM: Efficient Language Modeling with Shared Global State
abstract: arXiv:2609.33465v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Improving language model efficiency requires not only cheaper operations but also eliminating redundant computation. We argue that effective modeling requires information accessibility and computational depth, but not repeated historical retrieval across layers. Guided by this principle, we introduce the Global State Model (GSM), a causal encoder--decoder architecture that separates historical information acquisition from deep computation. The encoder progressively aggregates long-range information through multi-stage sparse retrieval into a fixed-size shared state, while decoder layers perform successive transformations over this state without repeated historical access. This design makes decoder attention and cache costs independent of history length, while dependency-aware pruning further reduces prefill computation. Experiments across multiple model scales show that GSM achieves downstream performance comparable to matched DeepSe

translated_title: GSM：基于共享全局状态的高效语言建模
translated_abstract: 提升语言模型的效率不仅需要更廉价的运算操作，还需要消除冗余计算。我们认为，有效的建模需要信息的可访问性和计算深度，但不需要跨层重复的历史检索。基于这一原则，我们提出了全局状态模型，这是一种因果编码器-解码器架构，将历史信息获取与深度计算相分离。编码器通过多阶段稀疏检索逐步将长程信息聚合到一个固定大小的共享状态中，而解码器各层则在该状态上进行连续变换，无需重复访问历史信息。这种设计使解码器的注意力开销和缓存成本与历史长度无关，同时依赖感知剪枝进一步减少了预填充计算。在多个模型规模上的实验表明，GSM 在下游性能上可与同等规模的 DeepSe（摘要在此处被截断）相媲美。
tldr: GSM 提出了一种将历史信息获取与深度计算分离的因果编码器-解码器架构，通过固定大小的共享全局状态使解码器的注意力开销与缓存成本不受历史长度限制，同时结合依赖感知剪枝降低预填充计算，实现与主流模型相当的高效语言建模。
